about.title: About
about.description: Full-Stack Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience specializing in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and Node.js. Skilled in designing scalable frontend architectures, optimizing application performance, building real-time systems with WebSockets and REST APIs, and developing backend automation services with NestJS. Strong background in system modernization, CI/CD practices, and technical leadership across enterprise environments.

features: Promoted from Junior to Mid-Level after leading architectural modernization, performance optimization, and backend automation initiatives across React and Node.js systems
contributions: Drove architectural decisions in a multi-year migration from ExtJS to React, collaborating with cross-functional teams to define frontend stack, libraries, and performance strategies while redesigning a core time-tracking system that improved usability and received positive client feedback;

Designed and implemented a scalable real-time dashboard architecture using WebSockets and React Query, combined with a configuration-driven system capable of generating complete dashboard structures from a single file, reducing development complexity and accelerating delivery;

Reduced internationalization overhead by 94.5% (1,518 ms → 84 ms per session) by implementing a language-keyed static cache with controlled invalidation, eliminating redundant processing during high-frequency React re-renders;

Led the migration from Create React App to Vite, rebuilding project configuration from scratch and introducing ESLint, Prettier, and modern tooling standards to improve maintainability and developer experience;

Built backend automation services with NestJS, Node.js, and Puppeteer to automate data extraction from legacy web portals without APIs, including resolving cross-platform Chromium certificate handling issues across Linux and Windows;
Developed the backend foundation of an AI assistant using NestJS and LangChain, enabling contextual question answering over company documentation through knowledge base integration;

Established the initial testing foundation with unit and end-to-end testing using Vitest, introduced code review practices, and led internal technical sessions on React performance, frontend architecture, and AI-assisted development practices.
Built approximately 80% of the frontend of a solar monitoring platform MVP for enterprise clients within a 3-month delivery cycle using Vue.js.

thesis.title: Development of a Web Platform to Simplify the Creation of YAML Workflows
thesis.description: The goal of this project was to develop a platform that reduces the difficulties and simplifies the creation of YAML files in an intelligent, guided, and explanatory way. The proposal aimed to especially support beginner developers, offering a more accessible and user-friendly experience while reducing the learning curve.
